_comment: Building classification for tools/geo-buildings.mjs (P4.1). Heights are roof - base (median first return over the lowest ground, m). Land-use floor areas are DataSF Land Use square feet; residential floor area is not in the dataset and is estimated as resunits x resUnitSqft (an assumption, not data). Rules are tried in order; the first that matches wins, then the fallbacks. Tuned on docs/review/p4/types.svg; counts in docs/reports/building-types-<box>.md.
civicNames: City Hall|Courthouse|Federal Building|State Office|Library|Museum|Church|Cathedral|Opera|Symphony|Memorial|Theatre|Theater|Asian Art|Post Office|Fire Station|Police|School|Mint

palettes._comment: Palette sets by neighbourhood (DataSF streets nhood of the nearest street; Chinatown from analysis_neighborhood). The colours of each set are in js/sf-style.js.

eras._comment: Era codes. From the Tall Building Inventory completion_date where joined (data), otherwise by type (an inferred rule, counted separately in the report). There is no year-built field in the datasets fetched.

facades._comment: Tall Building Inventory facade_material -> facade code: the material named first in the text (case-insensitive). 0 = unknown.
